verdict.rationale: Alloy versions its API under a pinned /v1 path. Deprecated endpoints carry inline warning callouts that name migration targets, such as moving to the Events API or to Investigations. However, there is no standalone versioning or deprecation-policy page and no API changelog, so the 'documented deprecation policy' half of the story is practiced only ad hoc. Missing for 10: a published deprecation policy with timelines and sunset guarantees, an API changelog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
